panels.material: Royal blue panel with burnt orange helmet
Left viewed from front: fire artwork

labels.title: Trebuchet arm
labels.description: The long arm carries the sling; the short arm is driven by the falling counterweight.

labels.title: Sling
labels.description: A facemask pouch rests on the baseplate inside the frame. The arm pulls it outward, then the sling sweeps up around the tip. One keyring stays attached; the other slips off the angled release pin.

labels.title: Tennis ball projectile
labels.description: A representative 67 mm tennis ball held in the sling. It launches out of frame and reappears when the arm resets. The flight is exaggerated for the animation.

labels.title: Counterweight
labels.description: The counterweight drops vertically and rotates the arm while the main pivot rolls along the horizontal tracks.

labels.title: Vertical track
labels.description: The vertical guide constrains the counterweight axle as the weight falls.

labels.title: Horizontal track
labels.description: The horizontal tracks support the rolling pivot, allowing it to move as the arm rotates.
